author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನದೆಲ್ಲವ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಶರಣುಹೊಕ್ಕರೆ ಅವನ
ತನ್ನತನ ತೊರೆಯುತಲೆ ನೀನಾಗೆ ಬರುವ
ಬಿನ್ನಹವೆ ನಿನದಿರಲು ಭಿನ್ನನಡೆಯನೆ ತೋರ್ವ
ನಿನ್ನುಸಿರ ಅವನಿಗಿಡು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you leave all that is yours and take refuge in him,
giving up his own selfhood, he will come as you;
if your prayer is yours alone, he shows you a different way;
offer your breath to him, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: When we give up everything and surrender to the Divine, the Divine becomes one with us. Selfish prayers lead elsewhere. Offer your very life-breath to God.
